args.title: Fix password reset email link to point to the correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently contains a link that points to 'http://localhost:3000'. This causes issues for users, as this link is unreachable outside of the local development environment. We should update the BASE_URL to appropriately reflect the production environment by using the PUBLIC_URL environment variable.
